notes.title: We made a new game - 48h left! ⌛️
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36422902/05b2d3476516dc21799b8d1d157f8fad4bbe8140.jpg

Hello everyone 👋 !

After months without new games we are back with a cute new game called Little Rooms, it's a Hidden Object Game 🔍, HOG for experts, featuring 36 cozy and beautiful little levels with 4 (maybe 5) game modes!

The game is currently -25% but only for the next 48hours! 
Check the page before it's too late :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217260/Little_Rooms/?curator_clanid=36422902
